description: Accessibility test tooling for Razor components, built on bUnit: a WAI-ARIA rule engine (roles, states, ID references, required owned elements and context, accessible names, focusable content in hidden subtrees, nested interactive controls ...), accessible-name and focus-order inspection, keyboard…

A Fluent × macOS theme for Avalonia 12: neutral light/dark palettes, a customisable accent, Windows Terminal / SourceGit-style tabs that live in the title bar, plus BusyArea, ProgressRing and toast notifications.
sLocker for customers: locker pickups, locker locations, locker storage, the locker shop and locker resale, on the sApp core (Superroute.SApp).
sLocker UI kit for .NET: the pickup list and the locker map as view models on the sApp UI kit (Superroute.SApp.UI), shared by the WPF and WinForms kits.
sLocker UI kit for Windows Forms: the PickupList and LockerMap controls, drawn by the sApp Windows Forms kit (Superroute.SApp.WinForms) from the view models of Superroute.SLocker.UI.
sLocker UI kit for WPF: the PickupList and LockerMap controls, drawn by the sApp WPF kit (Superroute.SApp.Wpf) from the view models of Superroute.SLocker.UI.
